Subject: Proposed deep-dive windows & hosting details

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really helpful to understand the cardinal pain points around latency spikes during batch imports and the audit log requirements for your compliance team. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

Recap (2 min):
- Primary use case: near-real-time triage for event ingestion + user-facing summarization.
- SLO target: 95th pct latency < 200ms for interactive flows.
- Compliance: need exportable audit logs and SOC2 evidence for retention policies.

Proposed next meeting: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive where we will:
- Walk a short architecture sketch mapping your ingestion path to Redwood Dedicated.
- Demo tail-latency under load and the KV cache behavior.
- Review audit-log exports and retention settings.

Candidate windows (PDT):
- Tue Jun 6, 9:30–10:45am
- Wed Jun 7, 1:00–2:15pm
- Thu Jun 8, 11:00–12:15pm

Please pick whichever works best for your team and confirm the attendee list (below). Once you confirm a slot I will:
1) Send a calendar invite (I can create Zoom or Google Meet — let me know preference)
2) Attach a short mutual-action-plan and a one-page note on expected throughput numbers (attached)

Proposed attendees from Cardinal: Liam O'Connor (eng lead), Priya Raj (security/compliance) — add anyone else you want to include.

Redwood attendees:
- Sofia Ivanova — Solutions (host)
- Ben Carter — Sales Engineer (demo owner)
- Karthik Iyer — Platform Architect (deep-dive/ops)

Attachments: 20280601-redwood-mop-up-brief.pdf (1-pager), Cardinal-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft).

Thanks — aiming to lock a date today so we can get ops scheduled.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
